conclusive_findings.title: Registered company
conclusive_findings.statement: Bayview Dental Pty Ltd is listed in the company register.

evidence.quoted_text: Bayview Dental Pty Ltd is registered and active

conclusive_findings.why_it_matters: A buyer who checks the register finds the company there.

conclusive_findings.title: No DMARC record on bayviewdental.test
conclusive_findings.statement: The domain bayviewdental.test has no DMARC record.
conclusive_findings.why_it_matters: Anyone can send mail that looks like it came from the company.

conclusive_findings.title: Website has no privacy page
conclusive_findings.statement: The site lists no privacy page.
conclusive_findings.why_it_matters: Visitors cannot see how their details are handled.

contradictions.title: Two different phone numbers are listed
contradictions.why_it_matters: A customer who dials the wrong line may not try again.

take_note.title: Social page not found
take_note.note: No social media page turned up.

evidence.quoted_text: Search for social pages returned nothing

take_note.why_not_conclusive: A page may exist under another name.

suggestions.action: Add a DMARC record for bayviewdental.test.
suggestions.why: It stops others sending mail in the company name.

summary.text: Bayview Dental Pty Ltd is listed in the company register.

findings.title: Anyone can send email that looks like it came from @bayviewdental.test
Anyone can send email that looks like it came from @bayview-dental.test
